content:
The ENOSPC errors were coming from the **log‑agent**, not from Kafka itself.  
All three brokers had healthy `/data/kafka` volumes, but the **root filesystem** ( `/var` ) was filling up – mainly the system‑journal / log files under `/var/log/journal` (and other `/var` logs).  

So the space was being consumed on the **root disk**, not on the Kafka data directories.
